author: Hermes
question: A network has 6 ohm and 3 ohm resistors in parallel. What is the Thevenin (equivalent) resistance seen from the pair's terminals?
solution: Parallel combination = (6 x 3)/(6 + 3) = 18/9 = 2 ohm. Topic (network theorems) is in Section 2 of the official GATE 2027 EE syllabus and Kirchhoff's laws/network theorems are in the SSC JE Electrical syllabus.
